newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 484/485 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 484/485 per dollar.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 484.00/485.00 per dollar in quiet trade as moderate corporate dollar demand was met by gentle Central Bank sales worth some $60 million, traders said.
"The Bank sold what was required and that kept the exchange rate flat," said one.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
Brokers added that recent volatility in the interbank overnight lending market had also quietened, helping calm the exchange rate, with funds lent at between five and fifty percent.
"Government funds flowed into bank accounts today ... and that helped ease tightness," said one.
Earlier this week, the interbank rate soared as high as 90 percent on a liquidity squeeze.
